articles.title: Brandon Sanderson Talks Blightfall, Wheel of Time, and Games of Thrones in Exclusive Interview
articles.summary: In an exclusive interview with IGN, Brandon Sanderson discusses his new book Blightfall, reflects on the Wheel of Time cancellation "tragedy", and defends George R.R. Martin, explaining that, if asked, he wouldn't say yes to finishing the Song of Ice and Fire books.
body: Brandon Sanderson has long been one of our favourite go-to authors at IGN, and recently we had the pleasure of chatting with the bestselling author for an exclusive interview.

From the epic Cosmere Universe to his latest collaboration with co-writer Janci Patterson – Blightfall, which just so happens to be one of our best books of September 2026 – it’s safe to say we’ve become fully immersed in the fantastical worlds Sanderson has crafted.

But if you’ve ever wondered how he balances multiple projects at once, or where he gets his inspiration, he’s sharing all with us. We might even be a little closer to finding out what to expect from the first Mistborn movie, possible video game adaptation of his books, alongside new insights from Sanderson on Wheel of Time and George R.R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire.
Blightfall marks your second release of 2026 so far. How do you balance writing across several different stories and books at once?

articles.title: Explosive Elon Musk Documentary Likely to Be Dropped by Universal, Report Claims
articles.summary: Universal is reportedly reconsidering its release of a revealing Elon Musk documentary, despite it receiving rave reviews at recent film festivals.
body: Weighing in at four hours (with a 10-minute intermission), Musk is the work of prolific filmmaker Alex Gibney, who secured access to various figures close to the Grok owner in his personal life, as well as those who comment on his political influence.
But while an informative documentary on the world's richest man would likely put bums on seats, The Hollywood Reporter claims that Universal is now likely to drop the movie's full release.

Universal paid millions for the rights to release Musk back in 2023, before the now-trillionaire fully aligned himself with President Donald Trump. Today, however, there's reportedly hesitancy over launching the film, with the expected outcome now that the movie rights will be returned to Gibney for him to sell again elsewhere.

In a thread on Twitter/X, which Musk owns, former Wall Street Journal and NBC News journalist Matt Rivera recounted watching the documentary at Venice Film Festival, where it received a five-minute ovation, and listed an array of eye-opening details regarding the film's contents.

articles.title: Game’s Price Is Lower Because This Fall Is So Packed, Dev Admits
articles.summary: October is going to be a tough month for anyone on a budget, as a ton of big games are coming up. Sandwiched between an already-packed September and the November release of GTA 6, how does any game stand out from the pack?
body: "We've had many discussions over the past year about the price of Valor Mortis," developer One More Level and publisher Lyrical Games wrote in a statement. "We believe the game has the quality, fidelity, and playtime in its 20-hour story to go toe-to-toe with many 'full price' titles. Still, this fall is stacked, and there's high demand for your time and money."

One More Level added that cosmetic packs will also be released in the next few months, and if players want to support the studio, they can purchase a Deluxe Edition that includes unique weapon skins alongside the base game and a "major" story expansion arriving in 2027.

articles.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker’s Hunger Is a Dark Urge To Match Baldur’s Gate 3
articles.summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker’s vampiric hunger system has turned me into a serial NPC killer, and it's like Baldur's Gate 3's Dark Urge all over again.
body: This is an IGN opinion piece from Matt Purslow, who loves RPGs both on the tabletop and in video game form. He appreciates any game that has an interesting take on the evil within, probably because his first ever RPG character was the son of the god of murder.

My sword slices through the final soldier. As his body hits the forest floor, my work here is done: I have saved two innocent men from being marched to the draining camps. Ambrus, the vampire that rules over this region of Vale Sangora, is rounding up civilians and bottling their blood to create a stockpile of sustenance. It’s my job to disrupt all that, and this latest round of vigilante slaughter is part of that task. These men will not be drained today.

You see, I’ve made the poor decision of conducting this mission at night. When the moon rises, I become a vampire myself, and while that grants me a suite of helpful abilities, such as being able to turn into a wolf and walk up walls, it also means I need to feast on blood. And, well, after all that slaughter, I’m pretty hungry.
points: The Blood of Dawnwalker’s vampiric hunger system has turned me into a serial NPC killer, and it's like Baldur's Gate 3's Dark Urge all over again.

articles.title: GTA Is Like Barbie, Take-Two Boss Says
articles.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the most-anticipated game releases ever, and despite the enormous hype, Rockstar and owner Take-Two are going to market the game aggressively. Why does the game even need a marketing push?
body: Zelnick said 2023's The Barbie Movie is a good example of this.

“All of us saw the Barbie movie, and they marketed the living daylights out of that picture. Even though the IP is very well known. Secondly, it was out there for a while. We all got the joke of what it was going to be. They did a phenomenal marketing campaign. It was really everywhere, and, by the way, it worked," he told GamesBeat.
For any "broad-based entertainment" property, companies "don't have a choice" but to spend significantly to push a new release, and GTA 6 is no exception, Zelnick said.
"You always have to go out and create enthusiasm. So, awareness is one thing; enthusiasm is another thing. And we have to show people what they’re going to get," Zelnick said.
points: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the most-anticipated game releases ever, and despite the enormous hype, Rockstar and owner Take-Two are going to market the game aggressively.

articles.title: Physint Release Date-Estimate, Gameplay, And Everything We Know
articles.summary: After touring the wastelands of extinction-level events in Death Stranding, what's next for Hideo Kojima? The veteran game designer is keeping busy with two projects that Xbox will publish, and one of them is a return to his roots of tactics, espionage, and action: Physint.
body: Physint doesn't have a release date yet, and don't expect it to be out for quite some time. Kojima himself has said as much, as the earliest release window for the game could be as far away as 2030. Back in 2025, Kojima said he'd just started work on his horror game OD and that Physint was in a "conceptual" stage of development.

With the game so far away, we could be looking at a next-gen release when it does eventually arrive. Now that Xbox has stepped in to publish and help develop it, it's a safe bet that it'll launch for PC and whatever form the next-gen Xbox console, Project Helix, eventually takes.

Death Stranding 1 and 2 saw Kojima team up with several famous faces to play characters in his post-apocalyptic world, and for Physint, he already has several big names attached to it. Swedish actor Bill Skarsgard (It, Boy Kills World) will play the lead role in the game, and he'll be joined by Charlee Fraser (Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga), Don Lee (Train to Busan), and Minami Hamabe (Godzilla: Minus One).

articles.summary: The latest Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 trailer dropped a big reveal: renowned Danish actor Mads Mikkelsen will play the game’s villain, “The Archer.” Perhaps the most surprising part of the new story teaser is that despite landing this big name, he gets about two seconds of screen time.
body: The trailer focuses on the conflict between longtime soldiers Captain Price and Ghost (that guy with the cool skull mask). Price announces that he’s willing to do just about anything to defeat “the enemy,” including working with cartels and assassinating his foes. In response, Ghost’s group is assigned to take out Price, who has gone rogue. Meanwhile, a war wages between North and South Korea, which seems like a bigger deal than whatever these former special forces BFFs have going on, but apparently not.

For those who played the original versions of these games but are a bit lost, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (not to be confused with Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare ) is the fourth entry in the rebooted Modern Warfare continuity. In this timeline, Ghost is more of a major character — as in, he isn't just a Boba Fett type with a cool design who gets unceremoniously blasted.

articles.title: MS Flight Sim Adds New Plane That Costs More Than The Game, And It Includes “Waste” Simulation
articles.summary: Microsoft has announced the next DLC for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, and it's a plane that costs more than the game itself. The Airbus A380 is now in the game, and you can get it for $74.50. For comparison, the game itself costs $70.
body: It is a digital version of the "superjumbo," four-engine, wide-body airliner made by Airbus. For people who aren't up to date with this kind of the thing, the A380 is the world's biggest commercial passenger plane, with 10 airlines operating them, including Emirates, British Airways, Qantas, and Lufthansa. There are fewer than 200 in service around the world.

The developers worked with longtime partners iniBuilds to make the A380 for Microsoft Flight Simulator. It's part of the game's "Exclusive Series," which means it will only be available for three months.

According to the developers, the in-game A380 is a highly detailed, carefully crafted virtual version of the plane, featuring "full fight deck modeling" and "extensive interactive controls, displays, and aircraft systems."

The plane features a long list of details to mirror its real-life counterpart, even including "potable water and waste simulation." Here's to hoping the pee and poop simulation systems aren't too realistic. The plane also has "functional on-board showers" for its digital recreation in Microsoft Flight Simulator.
points: Microsoft has announced the next DLC for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, and it's a plane that costs more than the game itself.

articles.title: Monster Hunter Wilds ditches one of its most hated features
articles.summary: While Capcom has been on a hot streak over the last few years, one of the publisher’s most annoying tendencies is adding strange microtransactions to some of its games, like Monster Hunter and Dragon’s Dogma.
body: Previously, after creating your hunter and Palico’s core appearance at the start of the game, you needed a Character Edit Voucher to make additional changes. Capcom sold a three-pack of Character Edit Vouchers for $6.99, a three-pack of Palico Edit Vouchers for $6.99, and a bundle of both for $9.99. While the company occasionally gave out free vouchers, monetizing this feature at all was ridiculous.

Thankfully, Capcom is finally coming to its senses. When Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance launches in 2027, editing your character and Palico's appearances will be free. Until then, Capcom will make these vouchers unavailable for purchase on Dec. 3, 2026, while giving all players 10 Character Edit Vouchers and 10 Palico Edit Vouchers for free. The company will also distribute a Special Thank-You Pendant Set to those who previously purchased any voucher pack, which includes the Heavenly Hog and Beezleboar.

articles.title: HBO's Lanterns Is Officially Changing Into an Entirely Different Show
articles.summary: Lanterns ' premiere episode ended with a shocking reveal: Hal Jordan, Earth's first Green Lantern, has been murdered. Fans were surprised, and quickly whipped up theories about how Hal might actually not be dead, especially as Lanterns had stressed that several aliens can appear human and even…
body: In the new trailer for Lanterns ' remaining three episodes, we see John Stewart (Aaron Pierre) and Hal (Kyle Chandler) meet up in Rushville in 2026. Hal seems to have been in prison since the events of episode 5 (set in 2016), when the Manhunter brutally devastated the small town. They have a tense conversation and, as John says at the end of the trailer, have a long way to go to repair their fractured relationship.

Of course, their time is cut short as Hal soon dies, setting up the mystery John and sheriff Kerry Kane (Kelly Macdonald) will presumably spend the rest of the season solving. Green Lantern Guy Gardner (Nathan Fillion) and his bowl cut also pop up, as well as Sinestro (Ulrich Thomsen), who gets a visit from John this time. By the looks of things, we might get a Hal Jordan origin episode, like how episode 3 was dedicated to telling John Stewart's origin throughout the decades.

articles.title: Valor Mortis is only $40 because its developer knows you'll be choosing from a lot of big games over this "stacked" autumn
articles.summary: The Valor Mortis developer has announced the game's price and offered an explanation as to why the team picked this particular price point. Valor Mortis costs $40 / €40, which is notably cheaper than other games releasing around the same time. We've asked for clarification on UK price.
body: The developer posted a message on X explaining its decision, saying that while it's confident in the game, it understands that players' time and money are at a premium in this period.

"We have had many discussions over the past year about the price of Valor Mortis. We believe the game has the quality, fidelity, and playtime in its 20-hour story to go toe-to-toe with many 'full price' titles," the developer wrote. "Still, this fall is stacked and there's high demand for your time and money."

Valor Mortis is the ambitious first-person Soulslike from Ghostrunner developer One More Level. It launches 13th October, notably in close proximity to Gears of War: E-Day, Ace Combat 8, Star Wars: Galactic Racer, Final Fantasy Resonance, and Phantom Blade Zero in October alone. It's also within striking distance of several big September releases such as Marvel's Wolverine, Silent Hill: Townfall, and Control Resonant - which you may recall is the game that caused Valor Mortis to be pushed back to October from its original 24th September release date.
points: The Valor Mortis developer has announced the game's price and offered an explanation as to why the team picked this particular price point.

articles.title: Following wide-ranging leaks, Bungie says Marathon is not 'merging' with Destiny
articles.summary: Destiny being reborn within Marathon sounds like one of those ridiculous ideas fans come up with to keep their hope alive, but it's one of several "leaked" plans Bungie supposedly has, which recently made their way online.
body: "As someone who's worked on both Destiny and Marathon, I can confirm that the 'leak' about us merging the two IPs is fake," Bungie veteran and Marathon creative director Julia Nardin wrote on X. "They share a lot of the same Bungie DNA, but like siblings they're also their own independent entities. Please don't believe everything you read online."

According to the leak, Bungie is apparently "testing the waters" to merge Marathon and Destiny into a single franchise "with Marathon representing the beginning of mankind's Golden Age and to foreshadow more threats to be used in a future Destiny project."

The wide-ranging leak apparently originated from 4Chan, and was later collated on Reddit. Though it mainly involves Marathon, it does touch on Destiny in some key ways. Nardin didn't directly address any of the myriad other leaked details, however.

That merger seemingly isn't limited to narrative and lore, the post said "multiple" former Destiny 2 developers have been rehired to join the Marathon team. Some of what those Destiny 2 veterans are working on is implementing ideas - initially planned for the game's cancelled expansions and sequel, into Marathon.

articles.title: GTA 6 is getting a 34-song original soundtrack, with music from multiple real-world artists - and you can stream six tracks today
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 's original soundtrack was partially revealed today. The full album contains 34 original tracks made for the upcoming open-world crime game.
body: The majority of tracks remain mysterious, with their titles simply listing their number on the album. However, Rockstar unveiled just six of them today, and they're available to listen to now.

Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album is available 19th November alongside GTA 6. It can be acquired on vinyl and CD, alongside availability on multiple music streaming services. Physical versions of the album are up for pre-order, priced $20 / £11 for the CD version and $50 / £45 for the vinyl. A limited edition vinyl with custom artwork is also available for $125 / £109 - though it has already sold out on the UK site.

You can pre-save the album to your account on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Deezer, Tidal and Amazon Music to be notified when the full thing goes live. The same link also lets you listen to the six sample tracks.

Today's reveal follows a string of teasers from the featured artists, who shared GTA 6-stylised posters on various social media platforms. More recently, one of the game's cast of actors has been confirmed as King of the Hill's Stephen Root.
points: Grand Theft Auto 6 's original soundtrack was partially revealed today.
The full album contains 34 original tracks made for the upcoming open-world crime game.
